title: kubeconfig: several users, only some holding inline secrets
summary: A synthetic kubeconfig with two clusters, two contexts and four users: one with an inline token, one with a tokenFile path, one with a username and inline password, one with a client-key path.
rationale: Real kubeconfigs are shared between several accounts. Only two of the four users hold a secret value inline; the other two hold paths, and a reader that treats everything in the users list the same way either misses the inline ones or reports the references. This is the file-format side of mixed and repeated secret layouts (#99).

expectation.rationale: Flag the inline token (alice) and the inline password (carol), and nothing is expected for the tokenFile and client-key path values. The client-go types document each field's meaning: token and password are values (datapolicy token and password), tokenFile and client-key are file paths; a kubeconfig holds lists of users and contexts.

sources.supports: Token and Password carry datapolicy tags; TokenFile is a pointer to a file that contains a bearer token; ClientKey is the path to a client key file for TLS.
Config has Clusters, AuthInfos (json users) and Contexts lists.
